title: Community Worksheets | Kindergarten Social Studies Practice Pack with Answer Key
desc:
📚 Common Core aligned: RI.K.1

Also aligned: C3 D2.Civ.6.K-2, C3 D2.Geo.2.K-2

Give your learners extra practice with Community! This no-prep printable pack has 7 practice pages plus a 2-page answer key for grown-ups. Just print and go.

WHAT'S INSIDE (11 pages)

  • Cover page
  • Community Helpers
  • Helpers and Their Tools
  • Places in My Town
  • Land, Water or Air?
  • My Community
  • Getting Around
  • Listen & Find Helpers
  • Answer key (2 pages): every answer, plus "Say" lines for listening pages
  • Terms of use

PERFECT FOR

  • Morning work, centers and small groups
  • Homework, early finishers and review
  • Homeschool lessons and summer practice

WHY TEACHERS LOVE IT

  • Clear directions young learners can follow
  • Friendly pictures that match each word
  • Listening pages keep the words in the answer key, so children truly listen

💰 SAVE MORE: this pack is part of the Social Studies Bundle and the Mega Bundle.

Terms: one license for one home or one teacher. Please do not share or post publicly. Thank you!
